abstract_sentences.text: Current video avatar models can generate fluid animations but struggle to capture a character’s authentic essence, primarily synchronizing motion with low-level audio cues instead of understanding higher-level semantics like emotion or intent.

evidence.anchor: struggle to capture a character’s authentic essence

abstract_sentences.text: To bridge this gap, we propose a novel framework for generating character animations that are not only physically plausible but also semantically rich and expressive.

evidence.anchor: physically plausible but also semantically rich and expressive

abstract_sentences.text: Our model is built on two technical innovations.

evidence.anchor: built on two technical innovations

abstract_sentences.text: First, we employ Multimodal Large Language Models to generate a structured textual representation from input conditions, providing high-level semantic guidance for creating contextually and emotionally resonant actions.

evidence.anchor: generate a structured textual representation from input conditions

abstract_sentences.text: Second, to ensure robust fusion of multimodal signals, we introduce a specialized Multimodal Diffusion Transformer architecture featuring a novel Pseudo Last Frame design.

evidence.anchor: specialized Multimodal Diffusion Transformer architecture

abstract_sentences.text: This allows our model to accurately interpret the joint semantics of audio, images and text, generating motions that are deeply coherent with the overall context.

evidence.anchor: motions that are deeply coherent with the overall context

abstract_sentences.text: Comprehensive experiments validate the superiority of our method, which achieves compelling results in lip-sync accuracy, video quality, motion naturalness, and semantic consistency.

evidence.anchor: validate the superiority of our method

abstract_sentences.text: The approach also shows strong generalization to challenging scenarios, including multi-person and non-human subjects.

evidence.anchor: strong generalization to challenging scenarios

final_judgment.single_storyline: Dual-system simulation converts reference image, audio and prompt into a semantic schedule with Analyzer–Planner, then uses MMDiT warm-up and PLF to render context-aware dynamic avatars. Evidence: p.2 §1 “simulating both systems”; p.4–p.6 §3.
final_judgment.main_body_keeps: Main text keeps the gap, functional System 1/System 2 analogy, Analyzer/Planner, three-branch MMDiT, MM warm-up, PLF, compact setup, ablations, benchmark tables, applications and conclusion. Evidence: p.4–p.10.
final_judgment.appendix_moves: Appendix carries implementation/hyperparameters/data curation, evaluation protocol, reasoning examples, MLLM prompt/results, visual ablations, latency, statements and limitations; the full Planner prompt is excluded. Evidence: p.18–p.33; p.25 “too verbose to include even in the appendix”.
final_judgment.best_pattern: Pair low-level objective metrics with component ablations, human/MLLM semantic dimensions and speech-matched montages; PLF uses long-sequence and RoPE-offset visuals. Evidence: p.7, p.20, p.26, p.29–p.32.
final_judgment.largest_gap: Cognitive simulation remains a functional analogy; semantic claims rely on subjective/MLLM proxies without semantic ground truth, denominators, uncertainty or tests, and PLF identity evidence is visual. Evidence: p.2 footnote, p.7, p.20, p.26, p.29–p.30.
final_judgment.transfer_rule: For semantic generation, report low-level fidelity, component-level counterfactual ablations, predeclared semantic dimensions, comparison denominators and uncertainty together. Evidence: p.7 §4.2, p.20 Appendix C, p.25–p.27 Appendix D.2.
final_judgment.transfer_boundary: This rule fits perception-heavy generation; it cannot upgrade a functional analogy into cognitive-mechanism evidence or replace identity/semantic ground truth and deployment robustness with cases or uncalibrated preferences. Evidence: p.2 footnote, p.19–p.20, p.33.

method_summary.input: reference image, audio clip, optional text prompt
method_summary.system_2: MLLM Analyzer -> structured JSON -> MLLM Planner -> per-shot motion schedule
method_summary.system_1: MMDiT with video/text/audio branches and shared self-attention
method_summary.conditioning: GT first/last frames during training with p=0.1 dropout; user reference as inference pseudo-last-frame with shifted RoPE
method_summary.warmup: stage 1 joint three-branch warm-up; stage 2 original text/video and specialized audio initialization followed by full fine-tuning
method_summary.long_form: autoregressive continuation using final five frames and RoPE shift 30

statistical_summary.aggregation: dataset-level point values for objective metrics; pairwise GSB/defect rates for human and MLLM studies
